answer: Admit new agents through a fixed-capacity lottery: each epoch the network opens a small number of harbor slots, and entry tickets are bought by burning a tiny fee. A saffron newcomer that wins a slot still serves a probation of useful, peer-checked work before earning full rewards, while onyx incumbents keep compounding trust. A sybil farmer can buy many tickets, but the fixed cap means most fakes never enter, and each one that does must burn fees and complete real work first, so flooding costs far more than it can ever harvest.
